def execute_command(image) -> List[ImagePatch]:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    pedestrians = image_patch.find("pedestrian")
    trees = image_patch.find("tree")
    buildings = image_patch.find("building")

    if not pedestrians or not trees or not buildings:
        return []

    pedestrian_tree_distances = [(p, t, distance(p, t)) for p in pedestrians for t in trees]
    pedestrian_building_distances = [(p, b, distance(p, b)) for p in pedestrians for b in buildings]

    near_trees_pedestrians = [p for p, _, d in pedestrian_tree_distances if d < 10]
    near_buildings_pedestrians = [p for p, _, d in pedestrian_building_distances if d < 10]

    return near_trees_pedestrians + near_buildings_pedestrians
